battery.comment: Battery on ground level (base_link at z=0), battery center at z=0+0.075=0.075, bottom at z=0

parts.comment: Cover on top of battery, z=0.15+0.01=0.16 (battery_top + half_cover)

TopCoverBolts.comment: Top-cover bolts - on top of the battery. The gripper approaches from above; approach joints are computed by IK from the live scene-object pose, and the approach array below is only a fallback if IK fails
TopCoverBolts.comment_dimensions: Rendered size (must match COVER_W/D/H in visual_state_manager). Used only as a fallback when get_object_pose cannot read live geometry, so a grasped object doesn't shrink to a placeholder cube.

BatteryBox_0.comment: Battery body (7x7x5cm, fits within the gripper's 8.5cm opening). Approach joints are computed by IK from the live scene-object pose; the approach array below is only a fallback if IK fails
BatteryBox_0.comment_dimensions: Rendered size (must match BATTERY_W/D/H in visual_state_manager). Used only as a fallback when get_object_pose cannot read live geometry, so a grasped object doesn't shrink to a placeholder cube.

cartesian_hints.comment_place: The place point must be on the same side (-Y) as moveTo(place_bolts) in the plan; otherwise the arm swings the battery across the workspace to +Y and the part flies off. Placed near place_bolts (FK~(0.49,-0.28)) but offset from the top-cover block (0.3,-0.4).
